title.narrative: Strengthening of the neonatology services in Ethiopia

description.narrative: L’Iniziativa, affidata alle OSC tramite apposito bando, e’ in linea con le strategie governative, si pone come obiettivo generale quello di contribuire all’obiettivo strategico “Improve maternal, child, and adolescent health and nutrition status” contenuto nell’ Health Sector Development and Investment Plan 2023-2025 del Ministero della Salute etiope, e come obiettivo specifico quello di migliorare l’accesso e la qualità dei servizi di cura neonatale essenziali e avanzati. Per poter raggiungere tali obiettivi, essa si struttura: i) migliorando le competenze del personale preposto ai reparti di salute materno-infantile e di neonatologia e ii) rafforzando a livello infrastrutturale e di attrezzature i reparti di neonatologia dell’Ospedale Suhul di Shire e del Black Lion Hospital di Addis Abeba

The Initiative, implemented by CSOs selected through a call for proposal, is in line with the governmental strategies. It has a general objective to contribute to the strategic objective “Improve maternal, child, and adolescent health and nutrition status” included in the Health Sector Development and Investment Plan 2023-2025 of the Ethiopia Ministry of Health, and as specific objective to improve the access and quality of the essential and specialised neonatal services. To do that, the Initiative will work on: i) improving the competencies of the health care staff working in the maternal and child health and neonatology departments in Suhul Hospital in Shire and Black Lion Hospital in Addis Abeba; ii) strengthening the infrastructure and equipment of the neonatology departments in Suhul Hospital in Shire and Black Lion Hospital in Addis Abeba.
